references.text: David in the book of Psalms expresses a similar thought about the importance of what comes out of the mouth and its reflection of the condition of the heart.
The prophet Isaiah criticizes the people for their speech, which reflects their hearts far from God, corresponding with Jesus' point about what the mouth expresses.
Luke gives a similar teaching from Jesus on how the mouth speaks what the heart is full of, emphasizing the connection between the heart and speech.
James warns about the tongue as a fire and a world of evil, resonating with the idea that what comes out of the mouth can defile a person.
